title: Option to additionally send weather alerts as notifications
line: The Weather Report widget now sends a notification when a new weather alert is issued for your location, with an option to turn it off.
explanation: Weather alerts (flood, frost, storm warnings from NOAA, DWD, Environment Canada) were only listed on the widget's Notices page, so you only saw them if you happened to open the popup. Nothing in the widget sent notifications. The weather data library's warnings now have their own headline and a stable identifier (NOAA and DWD fill in the headline, NOAA the id of the alert's event, which stays the same when the alert is updated), and the widget sends one notification per new alert with that headline, remembering which alerts it already announced. A "Weather alerts: Show as notifications" checkbox on the Weather Station page turns it off.

commits.message:
applets/weather: show weather alerts as notifications

Weather alerts were only shown inside the widget's popup, so they went
unseen unless it was opened. Warnings now have a headline and an id that
survives updates, and each new alert is sent once as a notification.

BUG: 517029
